title: MaceGlow
description: This Plugin enables Glowing when you have a Mace in your Inventory
body:
MaceGlow is a lightweight yet powerful Minecraft plugin that automatically applies a glowing effect to any player who has a Mace anywhere in their inventory. The effect updates in real time, meaning players start glowing instantly when they pick up a Mace and stop glowing the moment it is removed. No commands, permissions, or complex configuration are required — simply install the plugin and it works right out of the box.

This plugin is ideal for PvP servers, competitive events, minigames, or custom game modes where players carrying a strong or special item should be easily recognizable. By making Mace holders visible, MaceGlow adds clarity, balance, and new tactical possibilities to gameplay.

Designed with performance and simplicity in mind, MaceGlow runs efficiently even on larger servers and does not interfere with other plugins. Whether you want to highlight dangerous players, create unique mechanics, or just add a cool visual effect, MaceGlow is a clean and reliable solution that enhances both gameplay and player experience.
